prompt_en: Create a photorealistic Republic of Korea Armed Forces special-warfare campaign poster featuring the same unmistakably adult woman from the original reference portrait. Preserve her long oval face, eye aperture and spacing, jaw width, nose, lips, natural skin texture, and long dark wavy hair. The wide 16:9 landscape frame shows her upper body from mid-torso upward, positioned right of center so the battlefield remains visible across the open left distance. She shoulders a compact carbine and aims it straight toward the camera; both gloved hands control the weapon, and the circular bore, optic, and focused face form a strong foreground-to-face depth axis. The camera stays aligned just below her eye line. Behind her, fractured concrete barriers, churned wet earth, smoke columns, embers, and distant firelight establish an active war-torn battlefield. Wind drives smoke across the barriers as embers reflect in wet craters. Rain beads on her matte helmet and plate carrier while mud and ash cling to barrier edges. Cool storm daylight and restrained orange firelight bind operator and terrain into premium national-defense campaign key art: resolute, controlled, battle-ready, decisive.
